## 🤔 Qu'est-ce que GPT Image 2.6 (ChatGPT Images 2.6) ?

OpenAI a lancé Images 2.6 (ChatGPT Images 2.6 / GPT Image 2.6) le 4 novembre 2026 avec deux variantes API : `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst` et `gpt-image-2.6-flare`. Cette collection rassemble des prompts copiables et des exemples visuels pour la génération d'images, l'édition guidée par annotations, les prompts GIF natifs et les prompts vectoriels SVG. La variante utilisée est indiquée au cas par cas.

[Annonce officielle](https://openai.com/index/introducing-images-2-6/) · [Documentation du modèle](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-generation)

### GPT-Image-2.6 Flare vs Sunburst et flux clés

| Variante / Flux | Idéal pour | Voir les exemples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst (`gpt-image-2.6-sunburst`) | Détails élevés, mises en page complexes, typographie précise, cohérence de personnage multi-étapes, sorties GIF et SVG natives | [Cas à la une](#featured) |
| GPT-Image-2.6 Flare (`gpt-image-2.6-flare`) | Itération rapide à faible latence, brouillons express, génération à haut débit, éditions annotées, sorties GIF et SVG | [Tous les cas](README.md#all-cases) |
| Prompts GIF natifs (Native GIF Prompts) | GIF animés en boucle fluide (`output_format: gif`, 2–16 images) pour autocollants, démos et storyboards | [GIF et animation](README.md#category-gif-animation) |
| Prompts vectoriels SVG (SVG Vector Prompts) | Logos vectoriels propres et modifiables, icônes, concepts d'interface et ressources graphiques (`output_format: svg`) | [SVG et ressources graphiques](README.md#category-svg-design-assets) |
| Édition guidée par annotations (Markup-Guided Editing) | Entourez ou annotez une photo de référence pour recolorer un objet, remplacer un élément ou localiser une mise en page | [Annotations et retouches ciblées](README.md#category-markup-edits) |

<a id="api-quickstart"></a>

## ⚡ Démarrage rapide de l'API OpenAI (Flare et Sunburst)

Copiez un prompt de cette collection et exécutez-le directement avec l'API OpenAI Images (`gpt-image-2.6-flare` pour la vitesse ou `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst` pour plus de détails).

```python
import base64
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()  # Reads OPENAI_API_KEY from environment

# 1) High-detail still image with GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst (or "gpt-image-2.6-flare" for speed)
image = client.images.generate(
    model="gpt-image-2.6-sunburst",
    prompt="Editorial studio photo of a cobalt ceramic vase on warm oak, soft morning light",
    size="1024x1024",
    quality="high",
)

# 2) Native looping GIF prompt (output_format="gif", 2-16 frames)
gif = client.images.generate(
    model="gpt-image-2.6-flare",
    prompt="A tiny lantern-carrying monkey in a snowy pine forest at dusk, seamless loop animation",
    output_format="gif",
    frame_count=8,
    frame_duration_ms=150,
)
with open("loop.gif", "wb") as f:
    f.write(base64.b64decode(gif.data[0].b64_json))

# 3) Editable SVG vector prompt (output_format="svg")
svg = client.images.generate(
    model="gpt-image-2.6-sunburst",
    prompt="Minimalist bakery logo 'Field & Flour', clean vector silhouette, warm balanced negative space",
    output_format="svg",
)
with open("logo.svg", "wb") as f:
    f.write(base64.b64decode(svg.data[0].b64_json))
```

```bash
curl https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-image-2.6-flare",
    "prompt": "Minimalist geometric bakery logo on cream paper, clean vector aesthetic",
    "size": "1024x1024",
    "output_format": "svg"
  }'
```

</div>

<div align="center">
<a href="assets/examples/launch-higgsfield/source-03.webp"><img src="assets/examples/launch-higgsfield/source-03.webp" alt="Source image 3" width="700" /></a><br /><sub>Source image 3</sub>
</div>

**Prompt original**

**Starting image · Character and scene**

```text
Epic high fantasy anime key visual, mature seinen style like a modern high-budget anime film. A young woman sorceress-knight in her twenties with long crimson hair and sharp golden eyes stands on the edge of a cliff in ornate silver and emerald armor with a flowing royal blue cape, a glowing runic sword planted in front of her, magic sparks around her hands. Behind her a vast fantasy kingdom: floating islands with waterfalls pouring into the clouds, a white castle with spires, a huge ancient dragon flying in the distance, giant blooming sakura and golden autumn forests in the valley below. Sunset sky with vivid orange, magenta, turquoise and violet clouds, god rays, glowing magic particles in the air. Extremely vibrant saturated colors, dramatic rim lighting, cel shading with detailed painted backgrounds, crisp clean line art, depth and atmosphere, dynamic low camera angle, wide cinematic composition. Adult, elegant, serious heroic mood, not childish, no chibi, no sci-fi, no neon, no text, no watermark.
```

**Edit 1 · Sunset valley**

```text
Replace the moonlit landscape with a golden sunset over a misty mountain valley, winding river, waterfalls and ancient ruins. Keep the background softly blurred and the knight, armor, sword, rock and composition unchanged.
```

**Edit 2 · Floating castle**

```text
Replace the background with a majestic floating castle, smaller floating islands, cascading waterfalls and a dragon flying overhead. Preserve the warm sunset, atmospheric haze and shallow depth of field. Keep the knight and foreground unchanged.
```

**Edit 3 · Recolor armor**

```text
Recolor the armor to ivory white with rich gold trim, replace emerald gemstones with rubies, and change green fabric panels to deep crimson. Preserve the armor design, blue cape, red hair, golden sword glow, pose and background.
```

Use the edits in order, passing the previous output into the next edit. The official page includes the starting-image prompt alongside Edit 1; the three archived images show the edited results.

**Prompt original**

```text
Create an original, non-infringing logo for a company called Field & Flour, a local bakery.
The logo should feel warm, simple, and timeless. Use clean, vector-like shapes, a strong silhouette, and balanced negative space.
Favor simplicity over detail so it reads clearly at small and large sizes. Flat design, minimal strokes, no gradients unless essential.
Fully transparent background. Deliver a single centered logo with generous padding, clean alpha edges, and no solid backdrop, scenery, checkerboard, or watermark.
```

### 67. [Farmers market mobile interface](README.md#source-case-docs-market-ui)

<div align="center">
<a href="assets/examples/docs-market-ui/ui-farmers-market-gpt-image-2-6-flare.webp"><img src="assets/examples/docs-market-ui/ui-farmers-market-gpt-image-2-6-flare.webp" alt="Farmers market mobile app mockup — GPT Image 2.6 Flare (official model output)" width="700" /></a><br /><sub>Farmers market mobile app mockup — GPT Image 2.6 Flare (official model output)</sub>
</div>

<div align="center">
<a href="assets/examples/docs-market-ui/ui-farmers-market-gpt-image-2-6-sunburst.webp"><img src="assets/examples/docs-market-ui/ui-farmers-market-gpt-image-2-6-sunburst.webp" alt="Farmers market mobile app mockup — GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst (official model output)" width="700" /></a><br /><sub>Farmers market mobile app mockup — GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst (official model output)</sub>
</div>

**Prompt original**

```text
Create a realistic mobile app UI mockup for a local farmers market.
Show today’s market with a simple header, a short list of vendors with small photos and categories, a small “Today’s specials” section, and basic information for location and hours.
Design it to be practical, and easy to use. White background, subtle natural accent colors, clear typography, and minimal decoration.
It should look like a real, well-designed, beautiful app for a small local market.
Place the UI mockup in an iPhone frame.
```

<a id="using"></a>

## 📚 Mode d’emploi

1. Ouvrez un cas depuis une catégorie ou une fiche à la une.
2. Consultez les preuves relatives au modèle, les entrées requises, la source et les limites de réutilisation.
3. Suivez le lien du prompt original lorsqu’il est disponible. Un prompt manquant reste manquant ; ne le déduisez pas d’une image.

<a id="contribute"></a>

## 🤝 Comment contribuer

Ajoutez les cas sourcés dans content/source-cases.json et les prompts complets dans content/prompts.json. Le générateur crée l’index et les pages détaillées en anglais et en chinois.

[Guide de contribution](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Guide des cas sourcés et des médias](docs/SOURCE_CASES.md) · [Guide des langues](docs/LANGUAGES.md)
